Inter 4.1 (SIL Open Font License 1.1), copied unchanged from the `web/` folder of
the official release zip, https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/tag/v4.1.
Only the two variable fonts are bundled. Bundled rather than loaded from Google
Fonts because Google's copy drops Inter's character variants (cv05, cv08). To
update, replace these files from a pinned release and retain LICENSE.txt.
